hints.title: UTF-8 Leading Bit Counts
hints.text: A sequence begins with a leading byte that indicates character length: 0xxxxxxx for 1 byte, 110xxxxx for 2 bytes, 1110xxxx for 3 bytes, 11110xxx for 4 bytes.

hints.title: Continuation Byte Prefix Check
hints.text: Subsequent bytes in a multibyte character must strictly start with bits 10xxxxxx.

hints.title: Byte Counter Simulation
hints.text: Track remaining continuation bytes expected. If remaining is 0, check top bits of the byte to determine next sequence length. If remaining is positive, verify that top two bits equal 10 and decrement the counter. Check that remaining counter ends at 0.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of bytes in data array
complexity.notes: Linear scan with bitmask inspections and constant variables.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting bytes to strings incurs overhead; bitwise operators inspect prefixes directly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct bit shifts achieve O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly identify bit prefixes with masks or right shifts and handle trailing boundary conditions.
